review_candidates.title: Cloud Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Position Overview The Cloud Engineer designs, implements, secures, and supports the Company’s cloud infrastructure, with primary responsibility for Microsoft Azure and secondary support for Amazon Web Services (AWS). This is a hands-on intermediate role for someone who can independently deliver cloud infrastructure, automate repeatable deployments, troubleshoot complex issues, and translate technical requirements into secure, practical solutions for a distributed, multi-site operating business.
eligibility_evidence: Working knowledge of Windows and Linux administration, DNS, TCP/IP, routing, firewalls, load balancing, certificates, and hybrid connectivity.
